{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:Aat_negvv.png|thumb|right|250px|The Armored Assault Tank was a tank used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in it's [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]], and later used by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].]]
{{Quote|Tanks. Is that the best they can throw at us?|[[Rys/Legends|Rys]], during the [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|Mission to Rugosa]]|audio=Rys-Tanks.flac|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
A '''tank''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] frontline vehicle equipped with large or [[heavy weapon]]s and were a staple in many ground [[Army/Legends|armies]], their main function usually being to assist or spearhead attacks. Some [[Hovertank/Legends|hovertanks]] ran on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]], others used caterpillar treads, and others were [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. The [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] was considered the principal battle tank of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="SWE AT-TE">{{SWE|technology|attewalker|AT-TE walker}}</ref>
